t279: Privacy Statement of "My Yalla Annual Report"
t281: In order to show your Yalla annual report (14/5/2023-13/5/2024), Yalla will query and analyze the following user data based on your authorization to create your "Yalla Annual Report" (referred to as report).
t282: (1) Profile information, such as username and profile photo.
t283: (2) User's using records include date of registration, platform duration, date and duration of voice chat, rooms you joined and duration in the rooms, friends you added and friends you interacted with, the posts you sent in Moments (including videos), games you participated, gifts you sent (gold gifts and crystal gifts), gifts you received, whom you received gifts from and sent gifts to and your interaction with the platform.
t284: Please carefully read the Privacy Statement of "My Yalla Annual Report" and KKK of Yalla before participating in our activity.
t285: If you want to participate in this activity and agree to authorize Yalla to query and analyze your user data, please tick "I have read and accept the terms of Activity Privacy Statement" and click "Check" to get your report; if you don't want to participate in this activity, please do not click.
t286: We strictly protect your personal user data and will never disclose your reports to the third party. Your report is only visible to you unless you choose to share it with others. As report may display information about other users with whom you ever interacted, if you choose to share your report's content with a third party by taking a screenshot or posting in Moments,etc., please make sure that you have obtained authorization or permission from that user. When you share the report, you acknowledge that you have received all necessary authorizations and permissions from the owner of any portion of the report content and will take responsibility for that.
t287: If you want to cancel your authorization, you can contact us by sending email to RRR. We will not continue to query and analyze your user data for this activity after your authorization is cancelled.
t288: Important tips: This Privacy Statement is a representation and commitment to the privacy of "My Yalla Annual Report". If you want to learn more about the rights of data subjects and Yalla privacy policy, please check KKK.
t289: Please note that the report is an automatic result generated by the algorithm and may not show the details accurately.
t290: If you have any questions or suggestions, please contact us by sending email to RRR.
